title: Spine Mobility & Stability
summary: 2–3x/week (Tue/Thu/Sat). Thoracic mobility, gentle neck and upper-back strength, McGill Big 3 for the low back. No end-range neck rotation or loaded neck extension.

steps.name: 90/90 Breathing
steps.cue: Lie on back, calves on a chair, hips and knees at 90°. Slow breaths into the lower ribs and belly, long exhale. Upper chest and neck stay quiet.

steps.name: Cat–Camel
steps.cue: Hands and knees. Slowly round, then gently arch, through the easy middle range only; a warm-up, not a stretch. Neck follows the spine; don't crank the head up.

steps.name: Open Book
steps.cue: Lie on side, knees stacked at 90°, arms out front. Sweep top arm open behind you; eyes follow the hand. Hold 3 sec. Knees stay together; turn from the upper back.

steps.name: Thread the Needle
steps.cue: Hands and knees. Reach one arm under your body, then sweep it open toward the ceiling. Rotate through the upper back; hips stay square. Head follows gently, never to end range.

steps.name: Prayer Stretch
steps.cue: Kneel, elbows on a bench or chair, hands together behind head. Sit hips back and let the chest sink toward the floor. Breathe into the upper back. Head in line, not hanging.

steps.name: Doorway Pec Stretch
steps.cue: Forearm on doorframe, elbow at shoulder height. Step through gently until the chest opens. Shoulders down. Stop if hand tingling increases.

steps.name: Neck Isometrics
steps.cue: Hand on head. Press forward, each side, then into a turn each way at ~20% effort, 5-sec holds, 3 per direction. The head doesn't move. Stop if arm symptoms.

steps.name: Prone Thoracic Extension
steps.cue: Face down, chin tucked, eyes on the floor, arms by sides. Lift only the upper chest an inch or two from the mid-back; hold 2 sec. Neck stays neutral; never lead with the head.

steps.name: McGill Curl-Up
steps.cue: On back, one knee bent, hands under low back. Brace; lift head and shoulders slightly as one unit; hold 10 sec. Chin tucked, don't pull on the neck. Switch bent leg for side two.

steps.name: Side Plank (Knees)
steps.cue: On side, knees bent, forearm under shoulder. Lift hips to a straight line from knee to head; hold 10 sec, lower. Head in line with the spine.

steps.name: Bird Dog
steps.cue: Hands and knees, brace. Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back to hip height; hold 10 sec. Back flat, no hip hiking. Eyes down, neck long.

steps.name: Glute Bridge
steps.cue: On back, knees bent. Squeeze glutes and lift hips to a line from shoulder to knee; hold 2 sec, lower slowly. Ribs down; don't arch the low back.

steps.name: Child's Pose Breathing
steps.cue: Knees wide, hips back toward heels, arms forward. Slow breaths into the back of the ribs. Forehead on hands or a pillow if the neck strains.
